upgrade.title: Ibiro by'imari biri muri gahunda ya Premium
upgrade.description: Gushyiraho amafaranga y'ishuri, inyemezabwishyu, gukurikirana imyenda n'ibiguzi biri muri Premium. Ishuri ryawe riri muri gahunda itarimo.

dashboard.title: Imari
dashboard.subtitle: Amafaranga yose y'ishuri muri iki gihembwe
dashboard.nothingBilledDesc: Shyiraho amafaranga y'ishuri hanyuma usabe urwego rw'amashuri.
dashboard.noPaymentsDesc: Inyemezabwishyu zigaragara hano uko amafaranga akirwa.
dashboard.committedNote: Hari andi {{amount}} yemejwe ariko atarishyurwa. Ntabarwa kugeza avuye kuri konti.
dashboard.statementHint: Amafaranga y'ishuri yakiriwe, ibindi byinjiye n'ibyasohotse muri iki gihembwe
dashboard.nothingInDesc: Ubwishyu bw'amafaranga y'ishuri n'ibindi byinjiye bigaragara hano uko byandikwa.
dashboard.nothingOutDesc: Ibyishyuwe n'imishahara bigaragara hano bikurikije ibyiciro.

payments.title: Ubwishyu
payments.subtitle: Kwakira amafaranga n'igitabo cy'inyemezabwishyu
payments.referencePlaceholder: Nimero ya MoMo, iya banki cyangwa iya sheki
payments.noneDesc: Inyemezabwishyu zigaragara hano uko amafaranga akirwa.
payments.splitIntro: Bishyirwa ku cyasabwe cya kera mbere, byose ku nyemezabwishyu imwe. Kanda hano hepfo niba ushaka kugena amafaranga ya buri cyasabwe.
payments.tooMuch: Ibi birenze umwenda w'iki gihembwe wa {{amount}}.

debtors.title: Abafite imyenda
debtors.subtitle: Batangirana n'abasigaye cyane
debtors.allSettledDesc: Nta muryango ufite umwenda muri iki gihembwe.
debtors.bursaryHint: Ni igabanywa rikorwa igihe cyo gusaba amafaranga — si ubwishyu. Ishuri ntiryigeze ryakira ayo mafaranga.

structure.title: Igenamiterere ry'amafaranga
structure.alreadyInvoiced: Abo aya mafaranga areba bose bamaze gusabwa kwishyura.
structure.empty: Nta mafaranga yateganyijwe kuri iki gihembwe
structure.emptyDesc: Ongeraho ibyo ishuri risaba, cyangwa wimure iby'igihembwe gishize, hanyuma usabe kwishyura.
structure.invoiceTermIntro: Buri mafaranga akora n'abo azasabira ubu. Abamaze gusabwa barasimbukwa, bityo nta kibazo kubisubiramo.
structure.copied_one: Amafaranga {{count}} yimuwe. Genzura imibare mbere yo gusaba kwishyura.
structure.copied_other: Amafaranga {{count}} yimuwe. Genzura imibare mbere yo gusaba kwishyura.
structure.categoriesIntro: Ubwoko bw'amafaranga ishuri risaba. Icyiciro cyakoreshejwe ku cyasabwe gishobora guhagarikwa ariko ntigisibwe.
structure.editBilledNote: Hari imiryango yamaze gusabwa aya mafaranga. Impinduka zireba ibizasabwa guhera ubu; ibyamaze gutangwa bigumana imibare yabyo.
structure.name: Izina kuri fagitire
structure.namePlaceholder: urugero: Amafaranga y'icumbi, kwiyandikisha ku kizamini S6
structure.optional: Ku bushake: abanyeshuri bari hasi aha gusa ni bo bishyura
structure.optionalHint: Imodoka, amasomo y'inyongera, urugendo: ongeraho abanyeshuri babikoresha.
structure.studentsNarrowHint: Siga ubusa kugira ngo bose bari hejuru basabwe. Ongeraho abanyeshuri kugira ngo abo gusa basabwe (urugero: gusubiramo ikizamini).
structure.findStudent: Shakisha umunyeshuri ukoresheje izina cyangwa nimero…
structure.partsMustAddUp: Ibice byose hamwe ni {{total}}%. Bigomba kuba 100%, buri gice gifite itariki ntarengwa.
structure.previewSummary_one: Umunyeshuri {{count}} yasabwa {{total}} RWF ubu. {{skipped}} basimbutswe: bamaze gusabwa cyangwa nta cyo bishyura.
structure.previewSummary_other: Abanyeshuri {{count}} basabwa {{total}} RWF ubu. {{skipped}} basimbutswe: bamaze gusabwa cyangwa nta cyo bishyura.

settings.title: Igenamiterere ry'imari
settings.subtitle: Amategeko ibiro bikurikiza
settings.receipt_prefixHint: Inyemezabwishyu zikurikirana. Guhindura ibi hagati mu gihembwe bisiga imbanziriza ebyiri mu gitabo kimwe.
settings.late_fee_percentHint: Nta cyishyuzwa ku buryo bwikora — ni ibyo ibiro bibwira imiryango.
settings.grace_daysHint: Iminsi nyuma y'itariki mbere y'uko ibiro bitangira gukurikirana.
settings.bank_detailsHint: Acapwa aho imiryango ibwirwa uko yishyura.
settings.payeHint: Buri janisha rireba igice cy'umushahara w'ukwezi kiri mu cyiciro cyaryo gusa. Byashyizwe ku byiciro by'u Rwanda biriho ubu; bihindure hano itegeko nirihinduka.

payroll.title: Imishahara
payroll.subtitle: Ibyo ishuri rihemba abakozi baryo
payroll.noRunsDesc: Fungura uku kwezi, byuzuzwe biturutse ku rutonde rw’imishahara.
payroll.includeInRuns: Ashyirwe mu ihembwa rya buri kwezi
payroll.deductionNote: Ijanisha rikurwa ku mushahara mbumbe, atari ku nyongera. Amafaranga ashyirwa ku rupapuro rw’umushahara burundu, bityo guhindura ijanisha ntibihindura urwatanzwe.
payroll.payeNote: TPR ibarwa hakurikijwe ibyiciro biri mu igenamiterere ry'imari, ku mushahara mbumbe n'inyongera. Pansiyo ibarwa ku mushahara mbumbe gusa. Amafaranga ashyirwa ku rupapuro rw'umushahara burundu.

cash.title: Amafaranga na banki
cash.subtitle: Aho amafaranga ari koko
cash.noAccountsDesc: Ongeraho ikofi, konti ya banki n’iya mobile money, noneho buri nyemezabuguzi izajya igera muri imwe muri zo.
cash.makeDefault: Amafaranga ajya hano keretse umukozi avuze ukundi
cash.countNote: Ibi byandika ibyo wabaze. Ntibihindura ibitabo — gukosora itandukaniro ni icyemezo cyihariye.

budget.title: Ingengo y’imari
budget.subtitle: Ibyo bishobora gukoreshwa, ugereranyije n’ibyakoreshejwe
budget.noneDesc: Shyiraho ingengo y’imari y’iki gihembwe, buri kiguzi kizagereranywa nayo.
budget.noLinesDesc: Ongeraho ibyiciro uteganya gukoreshamo n’uko buri kimwe gishobora gufata.
budget.actualsNote: Ibyakoreshejwe bibarwa ku biguzi byemejwe cyangwa byishyuwe. Ikiguzi kitaremezwa ni icyifuzo, ntikibarwa.

income.title: Andi mafaranga n’imyenda ishaje
income.subtitle: Amafaranga atari ay’ishuri, n’imyenda y’ibihembwe bishize
income.noneDesc: Amafaranga ya kantine, imyenda, gukodesha inzu n’impano bijya hano.
income.arrearsNote: Kwimurira imbere bishyira buri mwenda ku cyasabwe kimwe cy'ibirarane muri iki gihembwe, kandi bigafunga icyasabwe cya kera, bityo umwenda ubarwa hamwe gusa, ntubarwe kabiri.

subtitle.owing: Abasigaye inyuma cyane mbere, ngo ibiro bimenye aho bitangirira
subtitle.charges: Buri cyasabwe cyatanzwe n'ibisigaye kuri cyo
subtitle.setup: Ibyo ishuri risaba, ababyishyura, no kubisabira

discounts.title: Igabanywa
discounts.intro: Rikorwa igihe basaba kwishyura kandi rigaragara kuri buri cyasabwe, ngo umuryango umenye impamvu byagabanutse. Buruse iri kuri konti y'umunyeshuri nayo irakora.
discounts.noneDesc: Abavandimwe, abana b'abakozi, buruse: bishyireho rimwe maze buri cyasabwe kibikurikize.
